proposed_future_ablations.name: Config A — Semantic Retrieval Only
proposed_future_ablations.description: BM25 and vector semantic search only. Graph traversal disabled; Evidence Field disabled; Verification Gate disabled.
proposed_future_ablations.rationale: Measures bug localization accuracy when relying strictly on keyword and semantic text similarity without structural code graph context.

proposed_future_ablations.name: Config B — Graph Retrieval Only
proposed_future_ablations.description: AST topological analysis: callers, callees, and dependency subgraph only. Semantic search disabled.
proposed_future_ablations.rationale: Measures bug localization accuracy when traversing only structural call and type graphs without semantic matching seeds.

proposed_future_ablations.name: Config C — Semantic + Graph Retrieval
proposed_future_ablations.description: Hybrid: Semantic search produces initial candidate seeds; graph tools expand neighbors and subgraphs. Contradiction tracking and Candidate Verification Gate disabled.
proposed_future_ablations.rationale: Evaluates standard modern agent architecture before introducing explicit Evidence Field and verification checks.

proposed_future_ablations.name: Config D — Evidence-Aware Localization
proposed_future_ablations.description: Semantic + Graph + multi-dimensional Evidence Field + contradiction tracking. Candidate Verification Gate disabled.
proposed_future_ablations.rationale: Isolates the specific contribution of contradiction tracking prior to enforcing the 5-point Candidate Verification Gate.

proposed_future_ablations.name: Config E — Evidence-Aware Localization + Candidate Verification Gate

methodological_guards.ten_fixture_boundary: All completed results reflect the project's internal ten-fixture regression benchmark. External performance on Kaggle's hidden evaluation test set is unobserved and unverified.
methodological_guards.no_overclaims: No claim of universal superiority, general SWE-bench rank, or statistical significance is asserted without large-scale external evaluation.
